trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) = 0 AND p.position <> 'Backcourt' AND CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <> 1989 RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player), (t:Team) WHERE p.current_team = t.team_name AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) = 0 AND p.position <> 'Backcourt' AND (t.founded_year IS NULL OR CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <> 1989) RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WHERE CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) = 0 AND p.position IS NOT NULL AND p.position <> 'Backcourt' AND t.founded_year IS NOT NULL AND CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <> 1989 AND p.current_team = t.team_name RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WHERE p.current_team = t.team_name AND p.olympic_gold_medals = '0' AND p.position IS NOT NULL AND p.position <> 'Backcourt' AND t.founded_year <> '1989' RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
